# Project Summary

This project is an R package that aims to provide a modern, user-friendly implementation of the "Equating Recipes" program, originally written in C by Robert L. Brennan, Tianyou Wang, Seonghoon Kim, and Jaehoon Seol. "Equating Recipes" is a comprehensive set of functions for performing various psychometric equating methods, as described in the book "Test Equating, Scaling, and Linking: Methods and Practices" by Kolen and Brennan (2004).

The R package will make these powerful equating methods more accessible to the R community, providing a robust and well-documented tool for researchers, psychometricians, and assessment professionals. It will cover a wide range of equating designs, methods, and smoothing techniques, mirroring the extensive functionality of the original C program.

# eqR

eqR is an R package that implements the test equating procedures from the "Equating Recipes" C program. This package provides a comprehensive set of tools for psychometric equating, making the methods described in Kolen and Brennan's "Test Equating, Scaling, and Linking: Methods and Practices" 3rd edition (2014) accessible within the R environment.

# Overview

Test equating is a statistical process used in psychometrics to ensure that scores from different forms of a test are comparable. "Equating Recipes" was developed to provide open-source functions for a wide variety of equating procedures, enhancing transparency and providing valuable tools for researchers. This R package aims to continue that mission by providing a modern, easy-to-use implementation of these methods.

# Features

This package provides a comprehensive set of functions for various equating designs, methods, and smoothing techniques, including:

Equating Designs:

- Random Groups (RG) 
- Single Group (SG) 
- Common-Item Nonequivalent Groups (CNEG) 

Equating Methods:

- Mean and Linear Equating 
- Equipercentile Equating 
- Item Response Theory (IRT) Equating 

Smoothing Methods:

- Beta-Binomial Presmoothing 
- Log-Linear Presmoothing 
- Cubic Spline Postsmoothing 
- Kernel Equating 
- Continuized Log-Linear Equating 

Standard Error Estimation:

- Delta Method 
- Bootstrap 

This is very much experimental and is currently only public for some random quirks of my development process. Use at your own risk/delight
